run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and every opportunity is captured at headline level from search-result snippets only. Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search. AusTender surfaced two genuinely new, currently-open Commonwealth opportunities not seen on prior runs: ATM D26/49129 (Asbestos and Silica Safety and Eradication Agency support for Aim 3 of the Asbestos National Strategic Plan 2024-30) and ATM_2026_3426 (Department of Industry, Science and Resources comprehensive company supply-chain dataset, closing 25 Sep 2026). Several other AusTender ATMs returned by search (RFT13109 pre-employment screening, PR10031930 RASS remote air services, RFI_ATM_2026_6026, CSIROEOI2026001 Parkes Observatory cafe) were already captured on prior runs or now closed, so were not re-added. NSW (buy.nsw), VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT returned only portal landing pages / generic aggregator results with no specific NEW current opportunity surfaced via search this run. Tier 2 covered universities (University of Sydney TenderLink items PROC-2026-293 chiller/cooling tower, SA31 student accommodation EOI, Curriculum Management Technologies EOI, Lead Architect EOI - all already captured on prior runs), GBE utilities (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water Cardinia Dam / biosolids EOIs, Transgrid Sydney demand-management, Ausgrid BESS - all already known or non-current) and public health (HealthShare Victoria JAGGAER portal - already known); no NEW specific opportunity surfaced. Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue, EstimateOne construction, HealthShare/JAGGAER): corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. Source discovery is saturating: every candidate source examined this run (HealthShare Victoria JAGGAER portal, app.jaggaer.com, EstimateOne, Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP Find Opportunities, AAICLAS) was already in the known-source set of 336, so no genuinely new buyer-originated source was added this run - reported honestly rather than padded.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of a degraded run, consistent with recent prior runs): WebFetch to external hosts is denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), reconfirmed this run against www.tenders.gov.au. The agent proxy status endpoint reported healthy (bundleCoversEveryHost:true, no recent relay failures) yet external host fetches are still policy-blocked, so this is an organisation egress policy, not a transient TLS/proxy fault; it was not retried or routed around per proxy guidance. Only WebSearch (US-based, via Anthropic) and the GitHub MCP were reachable.

Because no external detail page or specification document could be opened, deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contacts/closing-time could not be extracted for either tender; both entries are headline-level and pending a detail pass. Fields not present in search snippets are left null/"" rather than inferred.

AusTender D26/49129 (ASSEA Asbestos National Strategic Plan Aim 3 support): the ATM's own closing date could not be read from search snippets and is left null; only the scope (implement Aim 3, Priorities 7 and 8) and the two-year initial contract term commencing October 2026 were visible in the snippet. Full title, value, evaluation criteria, contact and documents were not readable.

Tier 1 states: AusTender and all state/territory portals could only be read through WebSearch snippets, not their live ATM/RFT lists, feeds or pagination, so full lists could not be swept. QTenders (QLD), Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders returned only portal landing pages / generic aggregator results in search (no specific new current opportunity surfaced this run).

Tier 3 SAP Business Network Discovery / Ariba: no specific currently-open, publicly-visible Australian RFx could be confirmed via search (results were generic platform/how-to pages). Corporate opportunities on Ariba/Coupa/BHP/Rio Tinto Buy Local/Fortescue/EstimateOne are registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals in discovered_sources, not as tenders. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Source discovery is saturating: of every candidate source examined this run (HealthShare Victoria JAGGAER procurement portal, app.jaggaer.com, EstimateOne, Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP Find Opportunities, University of Sydney TenderLink, AAICLAS aviation) all were already in the known-source set of 336. No genuinely new buyer-originated source was found this run; new_sources_found is reported honestly as 0 rather than fabricating one.
recommended_seed_additions: https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm?orderby=Close+Date - AusTender open-ATM list ordered by close date; when egress is unblocked, sweep this and follow pagination for full Tier 1 Commonwealth coverage instead of relying on WebSearch snippets.

tenders.title: Support for implementation of Aim 3 of the Asbestos National Strategic Plan 2024-30
tenders.buyer: Asbestos and Silica Safety and Eradication Agency (ASSEA)
tenders.description: An Approach to Market by the Asbestos and Silica Safety and Eradication Agency (ASSEA) for a supplier to work in cooperation with the agency to implement Aim 3 of the Asbestos National Strategic Plan 2024-30 (securing a worldwide ban on the production and trade of asbestos), specifically supporting Priority 7 (capacity building in South-East Asia) and Priority 8 (promoting the Australian Government's position on asbestos bans).
tenders.deliverables_summary: Provision of services under which the supplier works with ASSEA to advance Aim 3 of the Asbestos National Strategic Plan 2024-30 - securing a worldwide ban on the production and trade of asbestos - with a focus on Priority 7 (capacity building in South-East Asia) and Priority 8 (promoting the Australian Government's position on asbestos bans internationally). Full deliverables/milestones were not readable from the AusTender search snippet and the detail page could not be opened this run due to the egress block.
key_deliverables: Support for Priority 7 of the ANSP: capacity building in South-East Asia
Support for Priority 8 of the ANSP: promoting the Australian Government's position on asbestos bans
tenders.contract_term: Initial contract of two years, commencing October 2026 (as stated in the AusTender listing snippet)
tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch of AusTender current ATMs. Buyer-originated Commonwealth listing published on AusTender (the buying agency's own portal). Not present in the routine's known dedup keys from prior runs.
tenders.notes: Headline-level only. Scope/deliverables summarised from the AusTender search-result snippet of the ATM notice; the tender's own detail page and any specification documents could not be opened this run because external WebFetch is blocked by the environment egress proxy. Closing date, value, evaluation criteria, contacts and documents were not present in the snippet and are left null/empty rather than inferred. Pending a full detail pass on an unblocked run.
